unit: pieces of locally generated plastic litter prevented, collected or captured during four weeks
effects_source: actions.json effects fields are the single source of numerical values; do not duplicate a second editable effects matrix.
counting: Attribute a piece to its source location once. Exclude imported pieces from the receiving location’s baseline. Add effects only for the three selected action/location pairs.
interpretation: These are invented local litter-reduction counts, not empirical forecasts or measured quantities kept out of the ocean.
post_trial: No effect estimates beyond the four-week period. Do not claim future superiority or deduct guessed penalties from net trial effects.
